_readme: Settings for every Claude call. One provider: the Claude Messages API. The API key is not here; it is in Local/llm_key.json (see Docs/llm_key.example.json). Request body: model, max_tokens, system (the joined system text), messages [{role: user, content: <state JSON as text>}], output_config {effort, format {type: json_schema, schema: reply_schema}}, plus fallbacks when it is not empty. Headers: x-api-key, anthropic-version (api_version), content-type: application/json, plus anthropic-beta when beta is not empty. Read the first content block whose type is text; stop_reason 'refusal' or 'max_tokens', or a top-level type 'error', is a failed ask. reply_schema is the one reply shape for every ask (scene turn, Free Talk line, vote, reaction, closing line, tiebreak, input conversion); unused fields come back empty. The schema can't cap words or list lengths, so the game cuts speech and reason to 25 words and uses at most 2 actions.
